Pixel-perfect audit of /blog, /testimonials, legal pages, /services, and case study pages.

BASE: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq

## BLOG — 40 bugs
- Webflow: boldteq-v1-0.webflow/blog.html
- Local: src/components/blog/*.tsx + *.module.css
Sections: hero, category filter, blog grid (card layout), bottom CTA

## TESTIMONIALS — 25 bugs
- Webflow: boldteq-v1-0.webflow/testimonials.html
- Local: src/components/testimonials/*.tsx + *.module.css

## SERVICES — 30 bugs
- Webflow: boldteq-v1-0.webflow/services/website-development.html
- Local: src/components/services/*.tsx + *.module.css

## LEGAL (privacy + terms) — 20 bugs
- Webflow: boldteq-v1-0.webflow/privacy-policy.html
- Local: src/components/legal/*.tsx + *.module.css

## CASE STUDY PAGES — 50 bugs
- Webflow: boldteq-v1-0.webflow/our-works-pages/dabble.html (read this one deeply)
- Local: src/components/our-works-detail/*.tsx + *.module.css
Check: hero layout, meta row, content sections (challenge/solution/implementation/impact/features/tech), gallery, CTA row

### Method:
For every section: extract CSS classes → grep webflow.css → compare padding/margin/font/color/grid/radius with local → emit bug per mismatch. Check 5 breakpoints.

Output ONLY JSONL:
{"id":"SP8-NNNN etc","sprint":8,"page":"...","section":"...","component":"src/...","line":N,"category":"css|structure|content|responsive","severity":"P0|P1|P2|P3","title":"...","webflow_ref":"...","local_ref":"...","fix":"...","minutes":N}

Target: 165+ bugs total. Be exhaustive — even 1px padding difference = bug.
